name: digitalai-release-mcp
description: Run, manage, and troubleshoot your release pipelines with Claude
long_description: Claude works directly inside your Digital.ai Release pipelines: find and start releases, build templates with phases, tasks, and gates, manage variables and configurations, and pull activity logs to diagnose failures. Claude acts with the permissions of your Personal Access Token or your identity provider sign-in, and read-only mode lets you explore safely without making changes. Requires Release 26.1.5+.

release_url.title: Release server URL
release_url.description: https://release.mycompany.com — the base URL of your Release instance. — If your server uses a non-default servlet path or context root, paste the full MCP endpoint URL instead.

personal_access_token.title: Personal Access Token (leave empty to sign in with OAuth)
personal_access_token.description: Create one in Release under User profile > Access tokens. Leave empty to sign in through your identity provider instead (requires Release configured with OIDC; a browser login opens on first use).

cimd_url.title: Client ID Metadata Document URL (advanced — leave as is)
cimd_url.description: Identifies this extension to your identity provider, so it does not have to register a new OAuth client for every install. Change this only if your identity provider has no internet access and therefore cannot fetch the default URL: host a copy of the document where your IdP can reach it, set its client_id field to that URL, and paste the URL here. Must be https with a path.
